name: ANSI/IEEE frequency meter symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for frequency meter, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The frequency-meter form identifies the frequency of a specified measurement source. When several buses or generators appear on the drawing, the input path and selection switch determine which source is being indicated.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Read the source selection before interpreting the value.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Frequency indication differs from an underfrequency relay's trip or load-shed criterion.
